Name: Waterproof Items
Author: EscaMMC
Description:
[b]Waterproof Items[/b] causes items dropped in water to float instead of being destroyed. It also includes an option to automatically teleport floating items to the nearest player, making them easier to retrieve.
[line]
[b][size=4]Important Note[/size][/b]

Items won't disappear in water, but sometimes you might be unable to reach them. There are several solutions for this, including:

[list]
[*]Equip [b]magnet rings[/b]
[*]Enable the [b]Teleport Items Out Of Water[/b] option in this mod's config.json file
[*]Install more mods, such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4856]Enhanced Loot Magnet[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6326]Swim[/url]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]

1. [b]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/b]
2. [b]Download Waterproof Items[/b] from the Files tab, [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/WaterproofItems/releases]the Releases page on GitHub[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/807393-waterproof-items]ModDrop[/url].
3. [b]Unzip Waterproof Items[/b] into the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods[/i] folder.

[b]Multiplayer note:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]All players[/b] should install this mod for multiplayer sessions. Items may only float if the host and all nearby farmhands have this mod.
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]Options[/size][/b]

Waterproof Items includes options to teleport floating items to the nearest player and/or disable the visual "floating" effect on items in water.

To edit these options:

1. [b]Run the game[/b] using SMAPI. This will generate the mod's [b]config.json[/b] file in the [i]Stardew Valley\Mods\WaterproofItems[/i] folder.
2. [b]Exit the game[/b] and open the [b]config.json[/b] file with any text editing program.

See the [url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/WaterproofItems]GitHub readme[/url] for more information about each option.

This mod also supports spacechase0's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/url]. Players with that mod will be able to change config.json settings from Stardew's main menu.
[line]
[b][size=4]Translation[/size][/b]

Waterproof Items supports translation of its [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] options menu.

The mod will load a file from the [i]WaterproofItems/i18n[/i] folder that matches the current language code. If no matching translation exists, it will use [i]default.json[/i].

See the Stardew Valley Wiki's [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Translations]Modding:Translations[/url] page for more information. Please feel free to submit translation files through GitHub, Nexus Mods, ModDrop, or Discord.

The mod currently includes these translations:

[url=https://github.com/Esca-MMC/WaterproofItems/blob/master/WaterproofItems/i18n/default.json]English[/url]
